headline: Founder approvals executed to live completion, then the wave audited itself: /proof fully live with six new executing gates, link table live end-to-end, staging chain 28, release blockers 9→4 (all one external condition).

items.title: Every fix shipped with the gate that prevents its recurrence
items.insight: The retrospective found three defects in the session's own new work; each fix landed with an executing, mutation-tested gate (theme-boot contract, verifier↔writer binding). Fixes without gates are how the 100-session theme bug happened.

items.title: /proof completed: telemetry, permalink, skew honesty, sitewide badge
items.insight: The trust loop is now measurable (run/pass/fail events), shareable (?verified= links auto-re-verify), and honest about propagation timing vs tampering.

items.title: Content-lane dispatches answered locally before a founder is asked
items.insight: Three dispatches were spent learning what preflight-content-lane now answers in one local command — it caught its first would-be-stranded dispatch minutes after existing.

items.title: Staging ceremony run: chain depth 28, blockers 9→4 all-external
items.insight: After a Windows fix (tar/scp parse C: as a remote host), the attested lane deployed 4,453 files; every remaining release blocker is the single external real-provider-e2e condition.

items.title: CANON-053 adopted with a hash-bound rendered-pixel receipt
items.insight: The theme-matrix harness now emits docs/visual-qa/LATEST.json (16 captures, 7 themes) that the canonical checker verifies — the screenshot discipline that caught the theme-boot bug is now the compliance path.

followUps: Founder one-looks: CF token scopes · Actions secret · Zoho contact email
Restart loads autoMode.allow — dispatches become agent work
blockers: real-provider-e2e: external (Obelisk /auth/revoke + one founder sign-in) — now the ONLY blocker class
